payout_quote: Official Skillshare Help Center 'Earn From Your Teaching': 'As a Skillshare teacher, you can earn money when members watch and engage with your classes. Your earnings may include royalties from the Skillshare Teacher Fund, engagement rewards (for eligible teachers), referral earnings, and partnership revenue.' Eligibility: 'To qualify for monthly royalty payments, you must meet both of the following requirements by the end of each earning month: 1. Reach at least 50 followers: You must have 50 Skillshare followers on the last day of the month. 2. Meet the publishing or watch-time requirement: you must have published at least one quality class within the past 18 months and received more than 400 qualifying minutes watched during the month OR, if you have not published a new class within the past 18 months, have received more than 650 qualifying minutes watched during the month.'
steps: Create and publish a Skillshare class (video lessons, project-based).
Build to at least 50 followers by month-end.
Accrue qualifying minutes watched (400+ with a recent class, or 650+ without one) from paid members.
Receive monthly royalty payment from the Skillshare Teacher Fund (paid on/around the 16th of the following month).
catches: No dollar per-minute rate is published by Skillshare — royalties come from a variable Teacher Fund, so earnings per minute are undisclosed and fluctuate.
Strict eligibility: 50+ followers AND 400/650+ qualifying minutes per month; miss it and you earn nothing that month.
Only watch time from active paid subscribers counts — free trials, trailers, and free-access links do not.
Creating quality classes takes 20-40+ hours with no guaranteed viewers; most teachers earn little.
biggest_catch: Skillshare publishes no per-minute dollar rate — royalties are a share of a variable Teacher Fund — and you must clear 50 followers plus 400/650 qualifying minutes every month or earn nothing at all.
eligibility: 18+; class must meet Skillshare quality guidelines.
timing: Monthly royalty payments on/around the 16th of the following month.
